transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling really down and depressed, and it just doesn't seem to lift. This constant sadness has been going on for about two years and three months now. I just feel so weary and felt like I finally needed to seek help.
Can you tell me more about your low mood over these two years and three months, has it been consistently present or have you had periods where you felt somewhat better?
It has been completely constant, without any real breaks at all. I can't remember a single time over these two years where I felt truly better. It's just a continuous, heavy sadness every single day.
How has this constant sadness affected your daily life, such as your relationships, work, or ability to take care of yourself?
I'm not really sure how to describe the impact, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in those terms, as I've just been focused on trying to get through each day.
Do you find that you still enjoy or take pleasure in activities that you used to like before this period of sadness began?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about whether I still enjoy my usual activities or not lately.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns since this period of sadness began?

My sleep has been deeply affected; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly, have nightmares, and even when I sleep for a long time, I always wake up feeling unrefreshed. On the other hand, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my appetite. It is mostly my sleep that is completely ruined.
Have you experienced any feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or recurrent thoughts of death, either about yourself or others, during this period of sadness?
Yes, I feel deeply worthless and find myself constantly blaming myself for past mistakes. However, I haven't had any thoughts of death or wanting to end my life.
Can you describe the intensity of your feelings of worthlessness and guilt, and have they been present throughout the entire two years and three months, or have they varied in intensity over time?

These feelings of worthlessness are very intense and feel like a constant, heavy weight that I just can't shake off. They have been present pretty much the entire two years and three months, without really changing or letting up. It just feels like a continuous loop of feeling useless every single day.

Have you had any periods, even brief, where these feelings of worthlessness and guilt were significantly less intense or even absent, allowing you to experience some level of normal functioning or emotional relief?

No, I haven't had any breaks or relief at all. These feelings of worthlessness and constantly blaming myself have been completely constant throughout the entire two years and three months. I haven't experienced a single moment of normal emotional functioning or any letup from this weight.

For how long at a time can you go without feeling this overwhelming sadness and worthlessness, is it possible for you to have days or even weeks where you feel relatively okay, or is it a constant, daily experience?

It is a constant, daily experience, and I never have days or even weeks where I feel relatively okay. These feelings of sadness and worthlessness have been with me every single day without any breaks at all. This has been going on continuously for the entire two years and three months.
Can you think of any times or situations where your mood might have improved slightly, even if it was just for a short while, such as during vacations, holidays, or special events?

I honestly can't recall any times or events, like holidays or vacations, where my mood improved even a little bit. This feeling of sadness and emptiness has felt completely constant and unchanging over the last two years. It just stays the same no matter what is happening around me.
